bug_type: PDFium UTF16 raw-char unit decoding: get_text_range(i,1) returned empty for each surrogate half, losing supplementary mathematical glyphs.
correction: After unchanged source tight-bbox-center selection, pair only adjacent high/low surrogate code units on the same original page and within the selected source region. Decode to one Unicode scalar; retain both raw physical indices. Half-pair => UNKNOWN, no bbox expansion.
application: All R1 and W3 formula units; code source collector independently audited under same rule by heading agent. All integrated statistics/ROC recomputed.
BMP_preservation: All non-surrogate BMP input text remains byte-identical to original get_text_range; no raw control-code substitution. Only paired surrogate recovery changes text. Missing input text uses raw BMP scalar as fallback; actual collectors supply original text.
